findings.finding: Spread change was described as widening while the inversion became shallower.
findings.fix: Used increased for the +12 bps algebraic spread change; all values and bull-steepening classification preserved.

findings.finding: Private-banking leadership could misclassify the Pekao executive’s former role; the headline says he headed a private bank.
findings.fix: Specified prior experience leading a privately owned bank, without inventing a name or business-unit role.

findings.finding: Clinch-control wording could imply completed ownership transfer at Paramount.
findings.fix: Specified announced merger agreement, retaining Yahoo’s reported deal and adding CNBC n0753 for agreement status.

findings.finding: Operations begin to normalize was stronger than the available evidence of attempts to restore operations.
findings.fix: Changed to companies trying to restore operations and attached Reuters n1934, preserving uncertainty.

claim_checks.result: Matched Treasury 2Y 4.62%, 10Y 4.30%, spread -32 bps and twenty-observation -25/-13/+12 bps to own-card Treasury fields. Checked every quoted equity/ETF/index/commodity close and stated return against the exact completed 2024-07-09 line, including Nasdaq 100, Tesla +47.81% twenty sessions, Samsung local KRW, TSM US ADR and Polish total-return tracker in PLN. DXY +0.22%, TLT +0.93%, HYG +0.56% and LQD +0.91% are twenty-session values, distinct from negative daily bond-ETF moves. BTC/ETH use 2024-07-09 completed UTC daily closes. Payroll, unemployment and services PMI values match cited headlines. No numeric spot FX or unsupported target was found.

Read all 85 cited full titles, including newly added agreement and restoration-attempt sources. Powell growth-risk comments are already reported; CPI, China loans and bank earnings remain pending. Reuters loan poll is explicitly forecast, EIA/TrendForce output remains forecast, Samsung remains preliminary and TSM tight supply remains expectation. Nike June 27 warning is released earnings/guidance within fourteen days, not stale ordinary news. Older policy/affordability baselines remain within thirty-five-day macro eligibility.

BP refining and OMV legislation/inventory profit warnings remain indications with separate causes. Exxon’s exclusion of Pioneer remains attached wherever used. Tesla storage activity is separated from US vehicle-market share and deployment from margin. Mounjaro/Ozempic study remains study evidence rather than an approved indication. Asseco SEE is distinguished from other group entities. Pekao appointment, grocery searches, GPW product access and NewConnect revitalization are not converted into completed earnings, fines, flows or financing proceeds.

Indian equity mutual-fund June record, Goldman-attributed hedge-fund commodity buying and Temasek regional comparison retain their separate scopes. Bond ETF prices are explicitly not spreads or subscriptions. Selective bullish growth/power/health calls require orders, access, contracts or cash conversion. Bearish energy/BP and European autos retain conditions for covering or improving the stance; mixed Tesla balances storage with vehicle competition. Duration remains modest and conditional on long yields.

style_depth.assessment: All 36 blocks reviewed for meaningful mechanisms and explicit action/reversal conditions. CN treats expected loans, rate-control operations, resale/developer finance, cheap batteries, patents and tariff relocation as separate channels. PL compares inflation projections, household demand, mortgage cooling, executive/governance changes, security financing and exchange product competition, with substantive divergence. Sector and catalyst comparisons remain company specific without generic new padding.
style_depth.limits: The review validates headline-level claims and card identities. It does not infer unseen article content, private positions, unpublished data or subsequent outcomes.
